Senior Frontend Engineer
Pinecrest Learning

FICTIONAL job post for tests.

Pinecrest Learning makes reading practice apps for primary school classrooms. Teachers assign stories, children read aloud, and the app gives gentle feedback. We are hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer for our web app.

The role
- Build features in React and TypeScript, from design to release.
- Own our component library in Storybook with our designer.
- Make every screen accessible, with keyboard and screen reader support (WCAG 2.2 AA).
- Improve performance on low-end Chromebooks: bundle size, rendering, offline support.
- Write tests with Jest and React Testing Library, and end-to-end tests with Playwright.

Requirements
- 5+ years of frontend development.
- Expert React and TypeScript.
- Strong HTML and CSS, including responsive layouts.
- Accessibility experience.
- Experience with GraphQL clients such as Apollo.

Nice to have
- Next.js.
- Experience with education products.
- Web audio APIs.

$90,000 to $120,000 a year. Remote across Europe and Asia.
